name: Static site generator for German laws

mentions.name: Static site generator for German laws
mentions.description: This static site generator serves German laws in a format that is easy to cite, monitor, and machine-read, with predictable URLs that can be inferred from the law's name. It includes side-by-side AI translations marked as such, and is a refresh of gesetze-im-internet.de and buzer.de.
mentions.problem: The author cites many laws in their content and wants to automatically flag content for review when a specific paragraph of a law changes, and to automatically update their tax calculator when the values change.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A static site generator for German laws.

The goal is to serve the laws in a format that is easy to cite, monitor, or machine-read. It should also have predictable URLs that can be inferred from the law’s name. It will also have side by side AI translations (marked as such).
